description_en: Queries the detection results of image security scans
description_zh: 查看镜像安全扫描的检测结果
name: DescribeImageBaselineCheckResult

parameters.help_en:
The risk level of the baseline to query. Separate multiple levels with commas (,). By default, all levels are included. Valid values:

high: high risk

medium: medium risk

low: low risk
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的基线的风险等级。多个等级用英文逗号（,）分隔，默认全填。取值：

high：高危

medium：中危

low：低危
parameters.name: risk_level

parameters.help_en: The query condition for the baseline
parameters.name: criteria

parameters.help_en:
The query type of the baseline to query. Valid values:

BaselineNameAlias: baseline name

BaselineClassAlias: baseline category
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的基线的查询类型。取值：

BaselineNameAlias：基线名称

BaselineClassAlias：基线分类
parameters.name: criteria_type

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page when using paging. Default value: 20, which indicates that 20 logon configuration entries are displayed per page
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，每页显示的登录配置信息的数量。默认值为20，表示每页显示20条登录配置信息
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number of the current page when using paging. Default value: 20, which indicates the first page
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，当前页的页码。默认值为20，表示当前是第1页
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en:
The language type for the request and response. Default value: zh. Valid values:
zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为zh。取值：
zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

BaselineResult.description_en: The details of the image baseline check results
BaselineResult.description_zh: 镜像基线检查列表详情

items.description_en: The details of the image baseline check results
items.description_zh: 镜像基线检查列表详情

BaselineClassAlias.description_en: The type key of the baseline item

BaselineItemCount.description_en: The number of baseline check items

BaselineNameAlias.description_en: The alias of the baseline item

BaselineNameKey.description_en: The name key of the baseline item

BaselineNameLevel.description_en:
The risk level of the baseline. Valid values:
high: high risk
medium: medium risk
low: low risk
BaselineNameLevel.description_zh:
基线的风险等级。取值：
high：高危
medium：中危
low：低危

FirstScanTime.description_en: The timestamp of the first scan, in milliseconds
FirstScanTime.description_zh: 首次扫描的时间戳，单位为毫秒

HighRiskItemCount.description_en: The number of associated high-risk images

LastScanTime.description_en: The timestamp of the most recent scan, in milliseconds
LastScanTime.description_zh: 最新扫描的时间戳，单位为毫秒

LowRiskItemCount.description_en: The number of associated low-risk images

MiddleRiskItemCount.description_en: The number of associated medium-risk images

Status.description_en:
The fix status of the baseline risk. Valid values:
0: Unfixed.
1: Fixed
Status.description_zh:
基线风险的修复状态。取值：
0：未修复
1：已修复

PageInfo.description_zh: 分页查询时的页面信息

Count.description_zh: 分页查询时，当前页显示的数据条数

CurrentPage.description_en: The page number of the current page when using paging
CurrentPage.description_zh: 分页查询时，当前页的页码

PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时，每页最多显示的数据条数
